mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_survey_question ( question_id, survey_id, question_text, question_type, required_yn, scale_min, scale_max, sort_order, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{surveyId}, #{questionText}, #{questionType}, #{requiredYn}, #{scaleMin}, #{scaleMax}, #{sortOrder}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
